candidate_protocol: one complete ordered route proposal per task with one structured self-check marker per edge; accept no route state until an independent local validator checks the complete route

exact_offline_schema_audit.note: Frozen evaluator endpoints were used only to construct offline task packages and size schemas; truth fields were not added to the prompt.

calibration.method: For each of 130 requests, predicted input = calibrated intercept + slope * serialized prompt-plus-schema bytes; each slope is anchored to the observed mean input at the observed mean 8x8 size.

excluded_costs_and_unknowns: full-route output token use and response truncation risk are not observed and are excluded
input-token fit is extrapolated from 8x8 requests although exact 100x100 prompt and schema bytes are now measured; it is not a tokenizer measurement or confidence interval
Codex CLI account billing/plan decrement is not reported; Standard credits and API prices are rate-card equivalents only
R4-A/R4-B may use different input schemas and payload sizes; the candidate was sized from the R4 full-route prompt/schema only
decision_gate: Candidate remains unapproved. Before any model request, freeze protocol, verify output bound and whole-route rejection behavior offline, and set request/token stop gates.
